# Lucide icon subset

Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/main/icons

Retrieved 2026-10-06. Each URL returned HTTP 200 and `image/svg+xml` without authentication:

- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/main/icons/layout-grid.svg
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/main/icons/mouse-pointer-2.svg
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/main/icons/panels-top-left.svg
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/main/icons/image.svg
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/main/icons/type.svg
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/main/icons/eye.svg
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/main/icons/code-xml.svg

`icons.js` preserves the source geometry. It uses inline decorative SVGs, an 18px default size and 1.8px strokes to match the atlas controls. Workspace icons use 15px CSS dimensions. No remote assets or icon package load at runtime.

Lucide uses ISC; the `type` icon also retains the Feather MIT notice. The complete upstream notices are in `LICENSE`. Its URL returned HTTP 200 and `text/plain` without authentication:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/main/LICENSE
